# Pull Request Template

Thanks for contributing! Before you submit, please check the following:

- [ ] You opened an issue first to discuss the change (for anything beyond a small fix)
- [ ] You branched from `main`
- [ ] Your pull request is focused on one change
- [ ] You added or updated tests in `test/`
- [ ] You ran `npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build` locally
- [ ] You updated `README.md` if behavior or configuration changed
- [ ] You added a line under "Unreleased" in `CHANGELOG.md`

## What this PR does

Describe the change and why it's needed.

## Related issue

Link to the issue this resolves (if any).

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Type check passes
- [ ] Build succeeds
- [ ] README/CHANGELOG updated (if applicable)
